title: OpenAI GPT5 generateText with websearch tool consistently throws with error: APICallError [AI_APICallError]: Invalid JSON response

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/openai): support websearch tool results without query property
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Some OpenAI responses websearch tool results do not contain a `query` property (see #8264 ).

## Summary

Make `query` property `nullish` on both tool args and the response parsing.

## Manual Verification

- [x] verify that `examples/ai-core/src/stream-object/openai.ts` works

## Related Issues

Fixes #8264

Yes.
